stories.title: Sources: Alabama names Russell QB1 for opener
stories.summary: Alabama has named Keelon Russell as the starting quarterback for its Sept. 5 season opener against East Carolina, sources told ESPN's Pete Thamel.

stories.title: Yanks' Stanton suffers setback, return in jeopardy
stories.summary: Yankees slugger Giancarlo Stanton recently suffered a "moderate grade" left calf strain while rehabbing from a right calf strain, putting his return this season in jeopardy, manager Aaron Boone announced.

stories.title: Man United shocked by Hull loss in EPL opener
stories.summary: Manchester United fell to a shocking 2-0 defeat to newly promoted Hull City in their first match of the 2026-27 Premier League.

stories.title: Serena not in US singles, will pair with Alcaraz
stories.summary: Serena Williams will team up with Carlos Alcaraz to create a powerhouse mixed doubles pair in her return to the US Open. Williams, meanwhile, is not planning to play singles after the final wild card was given to Sofia Kenin.

stories.title: Former world champ Tete killed in South Africa
stories.summary: Former world champion boxer Zolani Tete was shot and killed at his home in South Africa, government officials said Friday. He was 38.
